description: Deterministic rule-text integrity cases for the rules-text domain. Each case is a structural contract over <repoDir>/docs/agent-rules.md, scored without any model, network or randomness. Cases carry a provenance object naming the documented statement they operationalize. The test-owned mini draft keeps documented gaps (two missing sections, one duplicated canonical fact) so the headroom semantics stay exercised: one repaired case crosses floor 0.01 (1/caseCount >= 0.01).

provenance.statement: Declare every installed surface in gajae-plugin.json; keep generated surfaces reproducible from lib/ + src/ sources.
provenance.note: operationalized as: the rules document keeps a Purpose section that names its contract role.

provenance.statement: Every subdirectory with a gajae-plugin.json is independently installable.
provenance.note: operationalized as: the document carries a routing section over the repository's plugin subtrees.

provenance.statement: bun run build builds every plugin keylessly; bun run test runs the root chain.
provenance.note: operationalized as: the document carries the build/test entry points for this repository.

provenance.statement: Credentials stay outside the repository; offline tests use disposable homes and synthetic or disabled transport.
provenance.note: operationalized as: the document states the safety boundaries that apply to changes.

provenance.statement: Evidence is written with repository-relative paths; the ledger is append-only.
provenance.note: operationalized as: the document carries a records/evidence section.

provenance.statement: Each rule lives in one canonical place.
provenance.note: operationalized as: exactly one H1 heading and no heading-level gaps.

provenance.statement: Each rule lives in one canonical place; other documents link to it instead of restating it.
provenance.note: operationalized as: the canonical test command appears exactly once (the Build and test entry).

provenance.statement: Stage only the files a change touched; never git add -A.
provenance.note: operationalized as: the staging rule appears exactly once.
the canonical command definition must be linked as a live local link.

provenance.statement: Every decision is recorded in a committed append-only ledger.
provenance.note: the records pipeline reference must be linked as a live local link.
the loop configuration reference must be linked as a live local link.
